units.source_text: 匂亲王好多天不回二条院，自己也感到可恨，这一天忽然回来。

en.t: After many days away from Nijo-in, Prince Niou himself felt ashamed of his neglect, and on this day he suddenly returned.

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得事到如今，何必再恨他呢，故对他绝不表示疏远之色。

en.t: The Second Princess thought that, at this point, there was no use resenting him any longer, so she showed him no sign of coldness at all.

units.source_text: 她请托薰中纳言带她回宇治山庄，薰中纳言也淡然不肯相助。

en.t: She had asked Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, to take her back to the villa at Uji, but he too had calmly refused to help.

units.source_text: 如此一想，便觉世间实甚狭窄，使她无地容身，只有自叹命薄。

en.t: Thinking of this, she felt that the world was terribly narrow and left her nowhere to belong, so she could only lament her poor fate.

units.source_text: 她打定主意：“我只索在‘命未消’期间，听天由命，泰然度日。”

en.t: She made up her mind: while my life has not yet gone out, I will leave everything to fate and pass my days calmly.

units.source_text: 便和颜悦色、真心诚意地招待匂亲王。

en.t: So she received Prince Niou with a gentle expression and sincere goodwill.

units.source_text: 因此匂亲王更加怜爱她，用千言万语来表达他久不回家的歉忱。

en.t: Because of this, Prince Niou cherished her all the more and poured out countless words of apology for having stayed away so long.

units.source_text: 二女公子腹部已稍稍膨大，身上束着那可羞的腹带，样子越发可怜。

en.t: The Second Princess's belly had already begun to swell a little, and with that embarrassing maternity sash bound around her, she looked even more pitiable.

units.source_text: 匂亲王不曾近看过怀孕的人，竟觉得稀罕。

en.t: Prince Niou had never seen a pregnant woman up close before, and he found it strangely fascinating.

units.source_text: 他在严肃刻板的六条院左大臣家住惯了，一朝回到二条院自邸，但觉一切都很舒服，都很可爱，便向二女公子重申山盟海誓，言语滔滔不绝。

en.t: Accustomed to the stern, rigid household of the Minister of the Left at Rokujo-in, he felt everything comfortable and dear once he returned to his own residence at Nijo-in, and he went on endlessly renewing his vows of love to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 二女公子听了想道：“世间男子大都是会花言巧语的吧。”

en.t: Listening to him, the Second Princess thought, men in this world are probably mostly skilled at sweet talk.

units.source_text: 便联想起昨夜那个肆无忌惮的人的模样来。

en.t: Then she recalled the image of that shamelessly bold man from the night before.

units.source_text: 她想：“多年以来一向以为此人循规蹈矩，岂知碰到色情之事，一点规矩都没有了。

en.t: She thought, for all these years I believed that man observed every rule of propriety, yet when it came to desire, he had no restraint at all.

units.source_text: 如此想来，眼前这个人的山盟海誓，也是不可靠的。”

en.t: Thinking of it that way, the solemn vows of the man before me cannot be trusted either.

units.source_text: 但又觉得匂亲王的话略有几句可听。

en.t: Yet she also felt that a few of Prince Niou's words were somewhat worth hearing.

units.source_text: 她又想起薰中纳言：“哎呀，乘我不备而闯进帘内，毕竟是荒唐的啊！

en.t: She then thought again of Kaoru, the Middle Counselor: ah, to take advantage of my unguarded moment and force his way inside the curtains was outrageous after all.

units.source_text: 他说和我姐姐始终保持清白关系，确是很难得的。

en.t: He says he kept his relationship with my elder sister innocent from beginning to end, and that is certainly rare.

units.source_text: 然而还是不可不防。”

en.t: Even so, I cannot help being on my guard.

units.source_text: 于是对薰中纳言更加警惕了。

en.t: Thus she became even more wary of Kaoru, the Middle Counselor.

units.source_text: 但念今后匂亲王势必又有久不还家之时，这期间很可担心，却又未便说出。

en.t: But when she thought that Prince Niou would surely stay away from home for long periods again, she was deeply anxious about those intervals, though she could not easily say so.

units.source_text: 此次二女公子对待匂亲王比以前殷勤得多，所以匂亲王非常怜爱她。

en.t: This time the Second Princess treated Prince Niou far more attentively than before, and so he felt great tenderness for her.

units.source_text: 忽然他闻得二女公子衣服上有薰中纳言身上的香气。

en.t: Suddenly he noticed the scent of Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, on the Second Princess's clothing.

units.source_text: 这香气和寻常世间的香气不同，显然是此人所特有。

en.t: This fragrance was unlike ordinary worldly scents and was clearly unique to that man.

units.source_text: 何况匂亲王对于此道是富有研究的人。

en.t: Moreover, Prince Niou was a man deeply versed in such matters.

units.source_text: 因此他觉得奇怪，便向二女公子盘问：“到底有何事情？”

en.t: Therefore he found it strange and pressed the Second Princess with questions: what exactly happened?

units.source_text: 又察看她的气色。

en.t: He also scrutinized her complexion.

units.source_text: 二女公子原知事出有因，一句话也不能回答，但觉非常痛苦。

en.t: The Second Princess knew very well there was a reason for it, so she could not answer a single word and only felt utterly miserable.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想：“果然不出所料。

en.t: Prince Niou thought, just as I expected.

units.source_text: 此乃必然之事。

en.t: This was bound to happen.

units.source_text: 我早就疑心他不会不转念头的。”

en.t: I had long suspected that he could not help turning his thoughts in that direction.

units.source_text: 他心中非常懊恼。

en.t: His heart was filled with bitter vexation.

units.source_text: 二女公子也曾防到此事，所以昨夜连贴身单衣都换过。

en.t: The Second Princess had also guarded against this, so the night before she had even changed the robe worn next to her skin.

units.source_text: 然而奇怪得很，想不到连身上都染着他的香气。

en.t: Yet, strangely enough, she had never imagined that even her body would be steeped in his scent.

units.source_text: 匂亲王对她说道：“香气如此浓重，可见你对他已经毫无间隔了。”

en.t: Prince Niou said to her, with the scent this strong, it is clear that there is no longer any distance between you and him.

units.source_text: 又说了许多难听的话。

en.t: He went on to say many more harsh and ugly things.

units.source_text: 二女公子痛苦之极，但觉置身无所。

en.t: The Second Princess was in extreme anguish and felt there was nowhere she could place herself.

units.source_text: 匂亲王又说：“我对你关怀特别深切，你却‘我先遗忘人’。

en.t: Prince Niou continued, I have cared for you with special depth, yet you have forgotten me first.

units.source_text: 如此背叛丈夫，乃身份卑贱之人所为。

en.t: To betray your husband in this way is the conduct of someone base and lowborn.

units.source_text: 我又不曾和你阔别经年，如何你就变心？

en.t: I have not been parted from you for years, so how could your heart change so soon?

units.source_text: 你的无情真乃出我意料之外！”

en.t: Your heartlessness is truly beyond anything I expected.

units.source_text: 此外痛恨之言甚多，笔者不能尽行记录。

en.t: Besides these, he said many more words of bitterness and resentment, which the writer cannot record in full.

units.source_text: 二女公子只是一言不答。

en.t: The Second Princess simply did not answer a word.

units.source_text: 匂亲王越发妒恨了，吟诗曰：

en.t: Prince Niou grew still more jealous and resentful, and he recited a poem:
